heroSection.title: Empowering communities through health and support services.
heroSection.description: Where compassion meets action in our mission to support orphans and people living with HIV.

aboutSection.subtitle: Hello Orphans and Infected Patients
aboutSection.description: Through our initiatives, we strive to combat stigma, promote social inclusion, and empower communities to build resilient futures. SOMI Haiti is dedicated to making a lasting impact on the lives of those we serve, promoting dignity, hope, and well-being.

project.title: We help more than 1000 children
project.subtitle: For the well-being of an orphan living with HIV!

tabContent.Mission: We aim to combat stigma, promote social inclusion, and empower communities by providing psychological support, educational assistance, health services, and economic aid. Through our dedicated efforts, we strive to foster resilience, dignity, and hope among those we serve.
tabContent.Vision: We envision a future where communities are empowered, resilient, and inclusive, with equal opportunities for all. SOMI Haiti is committed to creating lasting positive change and building a brighter, healthier future for the Haitian people.

causeSection.subtitle: Our Causes
causeSection.description: Our organization is dedicated to making a lasting impact on lives by providing resources and support to those in need.

content.Health Care: We are committed to providing quality care to people living with HIV and helping them understand the importance of taking their ARVs daily.
content.Education: We aim to equip these children with the knowledge and skills they need to build a brighter future for themselves and their communities.
content.Empowerment: Fostering community development through economic empowerment, social improvement projects, and infrastructure development.

featuresSection.subtitle: Our Features
featuresSection.description: With your help, we can make a difference in the lives of those in need. Join us in our mission today!

content1.Improving Education and Healthcare Acces: We aim to empower individuals to reach their full potential.
content1.Supporting Sustainable Development Goals: Contributing to the broader global agenda for a more prosperous world.
content1.Building Strong and Resilient Communitie: We create environments where individuals can thrive and overcome challenges together.

content2.Become an Volunteer: Together, we can foster resilience, promote inclusion, and empower our communities.
content2.Quick Fundraising: Your support allows us to provide essential services and assistance to those in need.
content2.Start Donating: Your donations provide vital support and services to orphaned children and individuals.

eventSection.subtitle: Our Events
eventSection.description: Our events offer opportunities to support our mission and connect with like-minded people.

Children's Recreation Day.description: After a year on the school path, it's good to go on an adventure. Join the children for a day of games and relaxation.

Awareness Campaign.description: An annual event during the patronal feast of the city of Les Cayes. A time of awareness about STIs and distribution of condoms.

Mobile Clinic.description: An annual event during the patronal feast of the city of Les Cayes. A time of awareness about STIs and distribution of condoms.

School Kits Distribution.description: Meeting financially struggling families to help children welcome the new school year with joy.

Financial Support for 100 Children.description: Meeting financially struggling families to help children welcome the new school year with joy.

Conference and Workshop.description: Taking advantage of World AIDS Day, a good opportunity to engage with the youth of the community. Conference and workshop on the theme 'Young People Living with HIV in Haiti! Dreams and Social Challenges.'

Fundraising Evening.description: SOMI has many long-term projects for the benefit of infected and affected individuals. This evening will be organized to allow benefactors to participate in this noble cause and contribute to the well-being of people living with HIV.

becomeVolunteer.subtitle: Volunteer
becomeVolunteer.description: Join us to make a meaningful impact by offering your time and skills.

volunteerSection.subtitle: Our Volunteers
volunteerSection.description: Their dedication, passion, and hard work drive our mission, making a tangible difference in the lives of orphaned children and people living with HIV.

TestimonialSection.text: SOMI Haiti provided me with the healthcare services I desperately needed. I am eternally grateful for their support in my journey to better health.
